subject: [PATCH v6 5/5] mm/memcontrol: add stock to the memsw page counter

2026-09-16.patch_summary: This patch adds a separate stock to the memsw page counter, allowing it to operate independently of the memory bank. The common drain scheduling is factored into schedule_stock_drain(), and the existing direct memsw rollback is preserved when memory charge fails. This change enables the raw counters for both banks to temporarily drift due to cached amounts, while maintaining the user-visible cgroup-v1 invariant by reporting the larger value.
